hud.divinitymc.quarantined: Armor data invalid - contact an administrator
command.divinitymc.equipment.hold: Hold a supported wearable item in your main hand.
command.divinitymc.equipment.help:
Individual armor properties (hold one piece of equipment):
/divinitymc held — view values and source
/divinitymc held set <physical> <magic> — edit only the held item
/divinitymc held reset — remove this item's override
Type configuration: /divinitymc equipment <item ID> set <physical> <magic>, affecting all items of that type without an individual override.
command.divinitymc.equipment.unsupported: %s is not a supported wearable item.
command.divinitymc.equipment.failed: Edit could not be completed. Check the configuration and server log: %s
command.divinitymc.equipment.get: %s: Physical Armor Capacity %s, Magic Armor Capacity %s; source: %s
command.divinitymc.equipment.set: Saved type configuration for %s: Physical Armor Capacity %s, Magic Armor Capacity %s (%s). Affects all items of this type without an individual override.
command.divinitymc.equipment.reset: Removed type override for %s: Physical Armor Capacity %s, Magic Armor Capacity %s; source: %s. Affects all items of this type without an individual override.
command.divinitymc.held.split: Split the held stack into a single item before editing or resetting its properties.
command.divinitymc.held.get: %s (%s): Physical Armor Capacity %s, Magic Armor Capacity %s; source: %s
command.divinitymc.held.set: Updated this %s (%s): Physical Armor Capacity %s, Magic Armor Capacity %s; source: %s. Only this item is affected.
command.divinitymc.held.reset: Removed the individual override from this %s (%s): Physical Armor Capacity %s, Magic Armor Capacity %s; source: %s. Type configuration is unchanged.
